text:
In a famous experiment, a scientist showed that, when water in an insulated tub is stirred, its
temperature increases.
What can be concluded from this experiment?
A
Temperature is a store of energy.
B
The water absorbs heat from the surroundings.
C
Work done by stirring increases the internal energy of the water.
D
Energy is not conserved.

options.label: A
options.text: Temperature is a store of energy.

options.label: B
options.text: The water absorbs heat from the surroundings.

options.label: C
options.text: Work done by stirring increases the internal energy of the water.
